look_here_first: Inspect alternate cauline toothed leaves on tall branched stems, then a rayless head with 8–12 florets and blunt to shortly acute phyllaries. Unlike A. runcinata, the leaves are not a deeply lobed basal rosette.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas state-native; no verified three-county project PASS.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate cauline elliptic/lanceolate leaves, dentate margins, sometimes clasping.
morphology_keys.heads: Clustered rayless heads, generally 8–12 disk florets; phyllaries blunt to shortly acute.
morphology_keys.habit: Branched leafy perennial, usually 30–150 cm; brown woolly basal hairs possible.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. runcinata has basal deeply pinnately lobed leaves and leafless scapes with 25–53 florets/head. A. microcephala has sharper spinulose leaf teeth and more pointed/mucronate phyllaries; head counts overlap.
